title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.13410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. translated_title: SteerDistill：通过闭环教师引导实现LLM智能体的量化
translated_abstract: 低比特量化可以降低LLM智能体的推理成本，但可能损害任务成功率。通过分析失败的执行轨迹，我们发现量化后的智能体往往会忽略任务要求或环境条件，导致环境状态转换偏离成功的全精度参考轨迹。纠正这些行为偏差仍然很困难：离线数据可能无法覆盖学生模型的失败场景，而其自身的执行轨迹在这些场景中又可能缺少正确的响应样本。我们提出了SteerDistill，一种量化感知的蒸馏方法，其中全精度教师模型引导学生修订失败的响应，并根据学生模型执行的反馈迭代地优化其引导。这种闭环教师引导产生了经过本地验证的行为修正。我们通过在无引导条件下训练学生模型，使其在修正轮次上匹配被引导后学生模型的预测以及全精度模型的行为，从而将这些修正内化。
tldr: 提出了SteerDistill，一种量化感知的蒸馏方法，通过全精度教师模型以闭环方式引导学生修订失败响应，并利用学生执行反馈迭代优化引导，从而在低比特量化下保持LLM智能体的任务成功率。
en_tdlr: SteerDistill is a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student in a closed loop to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using student execution feedback, preserving the task success of low-bit quantized LLM agents.
